title: The transaction update
source_identity: SOURCE-REVISION.txt and artifact-manifest.json identify the final committed packaging source. The validated local runtime was built from the approved source tree before its documentation commit.

windows_go_clean_suite.scope: Full clean suite before the final narrow gesture, CSS raster-policy and flow-note corrections; targeted follow-up checks validate those later changes.

final_local_windows_runtime.scope: Exact reviewed development executable. Full-header release packages and installer are a separate build and require their own checks.

affected_source_browser_suites.scope: Coverage and keyboard, docked workspace gestures, explicit modifier selections, composed transaction workspace, viewport navigation and raster policy, inscription isolation and stale responses, and progressive hierarchy. Controlled fixtures do not establish Bitcoin witness evidence.

real_bitcoin_viewport.scope: Ordinary Bitcoin data, complete maps, block-to-transaction-to-output navigation, exact output-local offsets, real isolated inscription content and persisted block cache. No synthetic picker entries are claimed as Bitcoin data.

native_content_browser.scope: Actual Go content server and browser security boundaries with explicit provider-reported local adapter fixtures; separate from native selected-chain reveal proof.

notes: This draft does not approve a new hosted updater release or change feed renewal policy.
Independent Transaction and Inscription browse-index policies default off and persist separately.
Indexing records, source block bytes and on-demand inscription content cache remain distinct.
Verified reveal-output assignments are not claims of current ownership or complete sat history.
Windows executables remain unsigned; local antivirus diagnostics do not establish cloud or other-machine clearance.
Development profiles, credentials, peer addresses and private local audit records are excluded from release inputs.
